reviews.text: We recently had the opportunity to work with a local roofing company for several projects on our house. From start to finish, i was extremely happy with their work. The first job was fixing some problems with our siding, and ayden came out to inspect everything. He quickly found out that the original siding had been installed wrong by the builder, and his crew got to work putting up the new siding the right way. The results looked perfect, and ayden even checked in later to make sure we were pleased. Not long after, a hailstorm hit and damaged our roof. I called the same roofing company again, and roger took charge of the project. He worked directly with our insurance adjuster and caught a few things others had missed. The new roof went up in just one day, which really impressed me, and they also came back soon after to put up new gutters. roger recommended we upgrade to 6-inch gutters because of the size of our house, and that turned out to be a great suggestion. The customer service was outstanding throughout. They even assigned us a supervisor, leonard, who was very detail-oriented and made sure everything was done just the way we wanted. leonard made sure both me and my wife were completely satisfied at every step. Communication was easy, whether by text or email, and we always knew what was happening. my wife and i fully recommend this company for anyone looking for reliable roofing or siding work.
reviews.author: Joel Arnold

reviews.text: After a heavy storm, my roof had serious damage and needed to be tarped while I got an estimate for repair or shingle replacement. I reached out to several roofing contractors, hoping someone could help quickly since roofers are always busy here with the strong Texas sun and storms. Simmons & Sons Roofing LLC stood out right away. Even though they were handling several emergency jobs, Jorge made time to come by early the next morning. He took detailed photos, secured a tarp on my roof, and provided a clear estimate for my insurance company. From that moment, everything moved efficiently. Anytime I had a question, they always got back to me within 30 minutes. The whole crew was professional, polite, and really knew what they were doing. The service was outstanding—they truly went the extra mile to make sure I was taken care of. The quality of both their work and the materials used was excellent. When the job was done, they made sure everything was cleaned up and my yard looked just as neat as before. I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone needing repairs or replacement.
reviews.author: Madison Vang

reviews.text: Out of all the roofing companies I’ve dealt with, Simmons & Sons Roofing LLC truly gave me the best experience. From the very first call with Theodore, I felt confident that my roof was in good hands. I received a fair and honest estimate for the work, and the crew made sure the project was finished quickly and done right. Throughout the job, Theodore kept me informed with regular updates on the progress. If you’re in Irving and need a new roof or repairs, I highly recommend reaching out to this team. Choosing them was one of the best decisions I’ve made.
reviews.author: bella ellis

reviews.text: I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone in the Irving area. After a major storm left our roof badly damaged, we chose them based on strong online reviews instead of going with the many contractors knocking on our door. Here are a few reasons why I would suggest them: 1) Communication – Leonard, the owner, gave us his direct phone number and was always quick to answer any questions, no matter the time. Scheduling the roof replacement and new gutters was straightforward, and they were always responsive. 2) Care and Quality – We have an in-ground pool and outdoor bar close to our house. Before starting the roof work, Leonard and his crew came by to make sure everything was well protected from nails and debris. They did a great job keeping our property safe and cleaned up thoroughly afterward. Jorge, the foreman, took real pride in their work and made sure the job was top-notch. 3) Attention to Detail – The team handled all the permitting quickly, so our roof was finished before many of our neighbors even got started. When we couldn’t decide on shingle colors from the brochures, Leonard gave us local addresses to check out the actual shingles in person, which made choosing much easier. 4) Honesty – We were open about our insurance claim, and Leonard was honest and fair in his billing. He submitted all the paperwork quickly, which helped us get our claim processed without delays. Overall, if you need a trustworthy roofer in Irving who does quality work and cares about the details, I would definitely recommend this team.
reviews.author: Sadie Calderon

reviews.text: I highly recommend this roofing company. Roger, our representative, was both friendly and professional throughout the entire process. After getting quotes from several roofers and starting with a couple of other companies, we were impressed by how this team offered the best price and handled everything thoroughly from beginning to end. We were on a tight schedule with our insurance, and Roger made sure our roof and gutter replacements were scheduled quickly. As a parent, I really appreciated how the whole crew was considerate and welcoming with my kids, and they made sure to clean up the area carefully so it was safe for the kids to play outside. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free.
reviews.author: Alfred Hendrix

reviews.text: I recently had my roof replaced and was very impressed with the entire experience from start to finish. The roofing company provided outstanding service and made sure everything went smoothly. Ayden, who handled my project, really stood out with his expertise and attention to detail. When I reached out about a leak in my roof, Ayden came out right away to inspect it. He explained everything clearly and made sure I understood what needed to be done. Ayden also helped me work with my insurance company, making sure all the paperwork and approvals were taken care of quickly and without any hassle. His professionalism made the whole process easy and stress-free for me. The actual roof replacement was finished in just two days, which was faster than I expected. Ayden’s crew worked hard and did a fantastic job, making sure every part of the roof was perfect. They cleaned up thoroughly after themselves, leaving my property neat and tidy. Overall, Ayden and the entire team showed a level of dedication and service that really impressed me. Their quick response, great communication, and skilled work made a big difference. If you’re looking for a reliable roofer in Texas, I highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: Jill P

reviews.text: the roofing team showed up on time each day, stuck to the budget, and delivered top-notch work. they were friendly, easy to talk to, and always cleaned up the job site before they left. even after the roof was finished, they helped answer all my questions and made sure i was happy. the crew, usually seven people, worked together smoothly, with several members having over 15 years of roofing experience—some even over 20 years. it was clear they knew what they were doing, which made me feel confident in their work as i watched them move quickly through each step of the job. they used only high-quality materials and didn't take any shortcuts. safety was a priority, especially since my roof has a steep slope, and no one got hurt even though they worked fast. the project also included removing an old, unused chimney from my house in irving, and they patched it up perfectly. you can't even tell there used to be a chimney there, and they sealed everything up well to prevent any drafts. the team, with jorge leading, showed exactly how homeowners hope contractors will do their work. i highly recommend this roofing company. they truly earned my 5-star review.
reviews.author: B B Baxter

reviews.text: While selling our home in Irving, the inspection found a loose section of shingles that needed to be fixed. Our realtor gave us the name of a local roofer, but they couldn’t help us for several months and didn’t know anyone else available. That same day, I spoke with Ayden from Simmons & Sons Roofing LLC and told him about our situation and the quick timeline we were facing. He was confident they could help, and he came out later that day to take a look at our roof and start working on an estimate. By the next morning, we had a detailed estimate and contract ready to go, and they promised to meet our deadline. The team finished the shingle repairs within two weeks, and while working, they found another small issue that the inspection had missed. They explained our options and took care of that repair, too. After finishing, they did a follow-up inspection and made sure everything was spotless before leaving. We were really impressed with how responsive Ayden was and the quality of the roof work. Our experience was great and we highly recommend this roofing company to anyone in the area needing fast and professional roof repairs.
